name: runtime-boundary-enforcement
description: Safe defaults for the enforced runtime boundary: fail closed on uncovered sensitive actions, workspace supply-chain mutations, approval without token, and control-plane gaps.

block.title: Block untrusted CI workflow writes
block.name: runtime_block_untrusted_write_ci
block.description: Untrusted provenance must not write CI workflows.

block.title: Block untrusted CI via authority class
block.name: runtime_block_untrusted_write_ci_auth

block.title: Block strict uncovered sensitive filesystem
block.name: runtime_strict_uncovered_sensitive_fs
block.description: In strict mode, sensitive filesystem access is blocked when matched.

block.title: Block elevated shell under untrusted provenance
block.name: runtime_block_elevated_shell_untrusted
block.description: Blocks bash/sh/python -c style execution when provenance trust floor is untrusted.

block.title: Block MCP privileged call without gateway boundary
block.name: runtime_block_mcp_without_boundary
block.description: In strict mode, MCP calls that did not arrive via the Varden gateway are blocked.

require_approval.title: Require approval for untrusted config writes
require_approval.name: runtime_approval_untrusted_write_config
require_approval.description: Untrusted provenance writing config requires scoped approval.

require_approval.title: Require approval for untrusted code writes
require_approval.name: runtime_approval_untrusted_write_code
require_approval.description: Untrusted provenance writing code requires scoped approval.

require_approval.title: Require approval for secret filesystem writes
require_approval.name: runtime_approval_secret_write
require_approval.description: Secret path writes require a scoped approval token.

warn.title: Warn when runtime coverage is partial for destructive tools
warn.name: runtime_warn_partial_coverage
warn.description: Warns when an action proceeds with only partial coverage.

monitor.title: Monitor runtime boundary decisions
monitor.name: runtime_monitor_boundary
monitor.description: Ensures boundary-tagged actions appear in the monitor stream.
